text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun. Did you get enough sleep 
last night?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Here, lean your face in a little closer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Mm. The bags under your eyes look 
lighter than the other day. Good. That 
puts my mind at ease.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"If that's what you thought, then reflect 
upon your actions. Good grief, you're the 
one who brought this on yourself."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I'll be off. To prove the 
equation of you and me."
